translations.translation: With the help of Heaven.
Shabbat Parshat Beshalach,
the 13th of Shevat,
the year 5711*

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section presents two seemingly opposite interpretations of the verse "She who dwells in the gardens," one referring to this world and the other to the Garden of Eden, and explains the concept of soul emanating from soul as a revelation of what was hidden.

translations.translation: "She who dwells in the gardens, the companions listen to your voice,"
and with this, the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Rebbe
(in his maamar
the continuation of the maamar of the histalkus)
brings two explanations that are seemingly opposites.
Explanation one
that "gardens" refers to
this world, and "she who dwells in the gardens" refers to the Congregation of Israel scattered in exile, shepherding in the gardens of others,
nevertheless, when she sits in synagogues and study halls,
then the companions, who are the ministering angels,
who are called "companions" because there is among them neither jealousy, nor hatred, nor competition,
listen to your voice.
And the second explanation
is that "gardens" refers to the Garden of Eden.
And although there are in this countless levels, nevertheless, in general they are divided into two levels: the Lower Garden of Eden and the Upper Garden of Eden,
and "the companions listen" refers to the souls in the Garden of Eden that are called "companions," as explained in the parenthetical maamar
that sometimes a soul
is emanated from a soul, etc.
And one can say the precise point in this,
that it informs us that the connection of souls to each other is not merely a connection, but rather a soul is emanated from a soul,
and the explanation of the matter of emanation was explained above
(in the discourse "I have come to My garden")
that it is a revelation of the hidden,
meaning that it is one thing,
it is the very same thing itself, except that it descended and was revealed from its concealment.
And like the hidden powers that afterwards descended and were revealed from their concealment,
therefore it is impossible to say that the intention in creation is for the sake of the World of Atzilus,
for since it is a revelation of the hidden, this is a descent,
rather, the ultimate purpose is this lower world.
And likewise is it with the connection of the aforementioned souls, which is a matter of emanation and revelation of the hidden.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the descent of the soul into the body, rather than merely being an obstacle, paradoxically strengthens it through the work of transforming concealment, and that the ultimate purpose of creation is specifically in this lower world.

translations.translation: And to understand the connection between the two explanations,
before this, the maamar explains
that when the soul descends below and becomes clothed in a body,
behold, even though the body conceals and hides,
nevertheless, through service, it removes the concealment and hiding,
and on the contrary, through this descent and clothing, it becomes strengthened with superior power.
And behold, the precise wording "and on the contrary,"
is as explained by the Alter Rebbe
(in Iggeret HaKodesh, section 25)
the words of the Baal Shem Tov
regarding the matter of anger,
such as when an uncircumcised person stands before him
and speaks and confuses him,
behold, not only is he not affected by him,
and prays as if the uncircumcised person were not confusing him,

but even more, it effects in him strengthening and an addition of power when he contemplates the matter of the exile of the Shechinah, which is clothed in a state of exile within this confusing speech.
It is found that through this confusion, the person is aroused more.
And likewise, the Mitteler Rebbe also explains
(in Torah Or,
the matter is in brief, but in Torat Chayim on this parshah
it is explained at length)
regarding the matter of "And it was when Pharaoh sent out the people,"
that the intention in this is that not only did the husk of Pharaoh not conceal and hide,
on the contrary, it even assisted,
as it is written,
"And Pharaoh drew near," and it is brought in the Midrash
that he drew near the hearts of Israel to their Father in Heaven,
and furthermore, "Pharaoh sent out the people" — Pharaoh went along with the people,
meaning that also the sparks that had fallen there ascended with them.
And this is also the precise wording "and on the contrary,"
meaning, not only does the body not conceal and hide the soul, and it remains in its state as if there were no concealment and hiding,
but on the contrary, through the initial concealment,
the person becomes strengthened with superior power.

And this is the primary intention in the creation of the worlds: the subjugation and transformation of the foolishness of the nations and the heat of the animal soul and worldly matters — into holiness.
And even though it is explained in many places that the performance of mitzvos is in order to add lights in Atzilus,
behold, it was already explained above
that the essential point of this is in this lower world.
And as the Tzemach Tzedek and the Rebbe Maharash wrote
that the lights as they are in Atzilus are like something placed in a box,
and not only is the primary revelation,
the primary Shechinah,
in this lower world,
and as was explained above
from the Rebbe
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory, at length, the explanation of the matter of the primary Shechinah,
behold, even more than this,
the Alter Rebbe explains
and it is also from the Maggid of Mezeritch,
in explanation of the statement of our Sages of blessed memory,
"Know what is above from you,"
"Know that which is above" —
all the matters that are above,
"from you and in you the matter depends."
